notes.text: New Spanish mortgage lending has shifted away from short reset periods: ECB data show loans that are floating or carry an initial rate fixation of up to one year fell from 19% of new house-purchase lending in June 2022 to about 8% in 2025 and in August 2026. New borrowers are therefore increasingly insulated from ECB moves during their initial fixed period, which dampens the immediate pass-through of rate changes to housing demand compared with the pre-2022 market.

sources.title: Share of variable rate loans in total loans for house purchase, Spain (RAI.M.ES.SVLHPHH.EUR.MIR.Z)

notes.text: The Right to Housing Law (Ley 12/2023) lets regional authorities declare stressed residential market zones for three years, where rents on new contracts may not exceed the previous contract's rent after indexation, and where large landlords (more than ten urban residential properties, or five or more if the declaration says so) are capped by a state reference price index, as are homes not let in the previous five years when the declaration justifies it. Zones must be declared by the competent regional administration, so the controls apply only where a region chooses to act and their effect on rents varies across the country.

sources.title: Ley 12/2023, de 24 de mayo, por el derecho a la vivienda

notes.text: Spain abolished its investor residence visa, including the route based on property purchases, by emptying articles 63 to 67 of Law 14/2013 through Organic Law 1/2025, in force since 3 April 2025. Applications filed before that date are processed under the old rules and existing permits keep their validity, so the effect on foreign buying in coastal and big-city markets is gradual.

notes.text: INE's Housing Price Index (IPV) is a quarterly index of new and second-hand open-market home sales by individuals, built from General Council of Notaries data received about one and a half months after the quarter ends and covering more than 90% of its transactions. It combines stratification with hedonic regression in a chain-linked index, with breakdowns by autonomous community.
